description: Opens an earnings call in the chat for the user: the recording with its synced transcript. Call it when the user asks to open, play, hear or read along with a call. Never call it to read a call yourself: GetEarningsCallTranscript returns the text and GetEarningsCallEvent the call's details.

fiscalYear.description: Company fiscal year. Omit both period fields for the latest call.

ticker.description: Company ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT), or MIC:TICKER (e.g., XPAR:AIR) for a listing outside the US.

name: ShowEarningsCall
title: Show Earnings Call
